decision_notes: This gate intentionally blocks production J jobs until a representative set has been calculated and reviewed.
Each result must bind input/output files and SHA-256 hashes for both methods.
For this two-compound package, the benchmark must cover aromatic H-H, aliphatic H-H and representative long-range H-C paths in benzamide and neutral (S)-prolinamide.
Routine 13C output is 13C{1H}; H-C benchmark pairs do not authorize proton-coupled carbon display.
Tol=1e-10, Z_Tol=1e-12 and the 6.05 A pair screen are locked in both methods; screen sensitivity must be reported.
The gate remains fail-closed until both PBE/pcJ-3 and PBE0/pcJ-2 results are hash-locked and reviewed.
